title: Doesn’t work with Spotify
body: It would be better if this app could use your Spotify playlist.

title: Perfect for Pass the Parcel
body: I downloaded probably a dozen similar apps and this has everything I needed for any of those types of games where you play music and need it to stop randomly, with no extra bloat. It just….works. Thank you. The highest praise I can give for this app is that I’d even be willing to pay for it.

title: Simple and perfect
body: Perfect to play musical chairs with your kids. Just open it up and hit play. The music plays for random amount of seconds between a minimum and maximum that you can adjust if you want but the default settings worked fine for me. The songs sound pretty good too. Nice to see there are still some solid, functional apps like this out there.

title: Was what I was looking for
body: I just wanted a app to play music and randomly turn off. I have tried other “musical chair” apps that did not ever do that. This one, as simple as it needs to be, was just right. Stops the music and changing intervals (can be adjusted) and automatically restarts as well (also adjustable how long the pause is).

title: Good app
body: Works well if you don’t have someone to turn music off and on

title: Perfect for playing WITH your kids!
body: Our kids often want us to play games like musical chairs, pass the parcel, etc. with them, but playing and controlling the music can be tricky. This app makes getting in on the fun easy!
